claims: WrestleMania 42 starts at 6 p.m. ET (3 p.m. PT).
WrestleMania 42's pre-show starts at 3 p.m. ET.
WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
In the U.S., WrestleMania 42 streams exclusively on the ESPN App via ESPN Unlimited.
The first hour of WrestleMania 42 simulcasts on ESPN2.
Fubo usually carries ESPN2 for the first hour of WrestleMania 42.
YouTube TV usually carries ESPN2 for the first hour of WrestleMania 42.
Hulu + Live TV usually carries ESPN2 for the first hour of WrestleMania 42.
DIRECTV Stream usually carries ESPN2 for the first hour of WrestleMania 42.
WrestleMania 42 is available on Netflix in most international markets.
WrestleMania 42 is available on Abema in Japan.
WrestleMania 42 is available on SuperSport in Sub-Saharan Africa.
The WWE Network has transitioned to ESPN Unlimited for PLEs in the U.S. as of 2026.
